title: 2007 AMC 10B Problem 5
statement: In a certain land, all Arogs are Brafs, all Crups are Brafs, all Dramps are Arogs, and all Crups are Dramps. Which of the following statements is implied by these facts?

answerChoices.label: A
answerChoices.text: All Dramps are Brafs and are Crups.

answerChoices.label: B
answerChoices.text: All Brafs are Crups and are Dramps.

answerChoices.label: C
answerChoices.text: All Arogs are Crups and are Dramps.

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text: All Crups are Arogs and are Brafs.

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text: All Arogs are Dramps and some Arogs may not be Crups.

solutions.text:
Writing the statements as implications, being a Crup implies being a Dramp, a Dramp implies being an Arog, and an Arog implies being a Braf: \(C\Rightarrow D\Rightarrow A\Rightarrow B.\)

So every Crup is a Dramp, an Arog, and a Braf. The only listed statement guaranteed true is that all Crups are Arogs and Brafs.

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Write each fact as an implication between the categories
Follow the chain \(C\Rightarrow D\Rightarrow A\Rightarrow B\)
